We’re so proud of FSU member Kathryn Sullivan for standing up and speaking truth to power. 💪

After 25 years at @commbank, and after helping train the very AI system that replaced her, Kathryn confronted the bank’s top executives to demand answers and fairness for workers.

This is why we fight for transparency, voice, and fairness in how AI is used in the finance sector!

Standing up to your manager about your workplace rights is never easy. But when you do it with the support of your team and everyone is in the same boat, the task can be a little less daunting. 

That’s precisely what a team of Westpac engineers did recently when their roles were moved down a level without adequate consultation. And they won!

Read more via the link in our bio.

Today, on the NSW Bank Holiday, please note that bank branches and non-bank branches across NSW should remain closed unless staff members have volunteered to work.

Exceptions apply to certain credit unions and building societies. Read more about these exceptions via our website, link in bio.

“I’m concerned that the 50% mandate is going to increase to 80%. I have two kids and the additional commute time is having a negative impact on my work life balance and puts unnecessary stress on my family."

This worker lives 85 km from the office. They joined Commonwealth Bank when work was completely remote and there was no indication from CBA that this would change. Since then, they have been required to change their arrangements to meet the 50% in-office requirements.

Our report shines a light on the experience of Commonwealth Bank workers who want more flexibility at work. We find out whether the reality matches the rhetoric by analysing results from a survey of CBA workers conducted by the FSU in 2025. Link in bio.

In a show of what finance workers can achieve when we stand together, Home Lenders at  Westpac  have successfully pushed back against unreasonable targets that were causing members unnecessary stress and anxiety.

Thanks for being part of our FSU community this past year. Don’t forget, your union membership fees are fully tax deductible. 

It pays to belong to our union!

Learn the benefits of joining the FSU  via the link in our bio.

The period leading up to the birth of a baby should be one of the most exciting times for any new parent.

But for FSU member Nicholas Mohr, it was one of the most stressful periods. All because his employer,a large insurance provider, cancelled his previously approved paid parental leave just weeks before his baby’s due date.

Read how Nicholas fought back and won via the link in our bio.

@westpac home lenders were left in tears after being told to post their daily sales numbers in a group chat ranking top and bottom performers. This is the kind of toxic culture the Banking Royal Commission warned about back in 2018. Thanks to pressure from the FSU, Westpac backflipped on these unfair targets.

Finance workers had a voice at this years Labor conference - and it paid off. From a Fair AI Taskforce to a new Fair Work Court, these are commitments that we'll be holding Labor to.
 
Swipe through to see what was won 👉

Thanks to recent wage theft laws introduced in Australia, workers like Adrian now have stronger protections. 

Employers who intentionally underpay staff face:
💰 $7.8M fines
🚨 Up to 10 years in prison

Adrian’s message to workers: ‘If you think you’re being underpaid, investigate. You deserve to be treated fairly.’

One of the many reasons you should join your union!
